failure_summary.description: Agents imported or used date-formatting logic instead of preserving user-provided date strings.
An agent searched for hotels even though the user had not requested lodging.
An agent inferred hotel cities and stay dates from flight legs and assumed an extra night.
An agent treated a cache entry as an existing variable and neither retrieved nor saved the filtered result.

patch.reasoning: No edits are warranted: the skill already prohibits date-library imports and unnecessary date conversion, unrequested domain searches, inferring hotel dates from flight legs, and using prior-turn variables instead of retrieving and saving cache results. Adding rules for these failures would duplicate existing content.
